verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation, such as filing-change alerts or rule-based actions, is a plausible capability for a business and lien registry portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual search, filing and ordering, plus fixed data, image and monthly subscriptions. Those subscriptions are scheduled bulk data products, not user-defined rules that fire actions on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
